stemMd: For nonzero a and b, simplify (a²b⁻¹)³/(a⁴b⁻²).
explanationMd: Expand the numerator to a⁶b⁻³. Dividing by a⁴b⁻² subtracts exponents, leaving a²b⁻¹ = a²/b. Nonzero variables ensure all negative powers are defined.

distractorRationale.c: This mishandles the negative exponent of b.
distractorRationale.a: This stops after expanding the numerator.
distractorRationale.d: This adds exponents when division requires subtraction.
distractorRationale.e: This reverses the remaining exponent of a.
